mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PBANC_PRCS_HSTRY (PBANC_SN, TRGT_TEAM_SN, PRCS_SE_CD, PRCS_RSN, PRCR_ID) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{trgtTeamSn,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{prcsSeCd}, #{prcsRsn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prcrId})
mapper.select: SELECT H.PRCS_HSTRY_SN AS prcsHstrySn, H.PRCS_SE_CD AS prcsSeCd, C.CD_NM AS prcsSeNm, H.TRGT_TEAM_SN AS trgtTeamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS trgtTeamNm, H.PRCS_RSN AS prcsRsn, H.PRCR_ID AS prcrId, U.USER_NM AS prcrNm, H.PRCS_DT AS prcsDt FROM TB_PBANC_PRCS_HSTRY H LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = H.TRGT_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = H.PRCR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PRCSE' AND C.CD = H.PRCS_SE_CD WHERE H.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} ORDER BY H.PRCS_DT, H.PRCS_HSTRY_SN
